mapper.sql: WITH decoded AS ( SELECT e.id, e.task_id, e.event_no, e.created_at, e.reason_code, e.metadata ->> '$.outcome' AS outcome, e.metadata ->> '$.summary.adapter' AS adapter, e.metadata ->> '$.summary.modelVersion' AS logged_version, CASE WHEN JSON_TYPE(e.metadata -> '$.durationMs') = 'INTEGER' THEN CAST(e.metadata ->> '$.durationMs' AS SIGNED) END AS logged_duration, CASE WHEN JSON_TYPE(e.metadata -> '$.attempt') = 'INTEGER' THEN CAST(e.metadata ->> '$.attempt' AS SIGNED) END AS logged_attempt FROM agent_state_event e WHERE e.event_type = 'MODEL_DECISION' AND e.created_at >= #{filter.start} AND e.created_at < #{filter.end} ), identified AS ( SELECT id, task_id, event_no, created_at, outcome, CASE WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(reason_code, '^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]{0,63}$', 'c') THEN reason_code END AS reason, CASE WHEN logged_attempt BETWEEN 1 AND 2147483647 THEN logged_attempt END AS attempt, CASE WHEN logged_duration >= 0 THEN logged_duration END AS duration_ms, CASE WHEN logged_version IN ('environment', 'built-in') OR REGEXP_LIKE(logged_version, #{filter.versionPattern}, 'c') THEN logged_version ELSE 'unrecorded' END AS version, CASE WHEN adapter = 'DemoDecisionModel' THEN 'demo' WHEN adapter = 'DeepSeekDecisionModel' OR REGEXP_LIKE(logged_version, #{filter.versionPattern}, 'c') THEN 'external' ELSE 'unspecified' END AS mode FROM decoded WHERE outcome IN ('SUCCEEDED', 'FAILED') ), model_events AS ( SELECT identified.*, CONCAT(mode, ':', version) AS model_key FROM identified ), filtered AS ( SELECT * FROM model_events WHERE #{filter.model,jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NULL OR model_key = #{filter.model,jdbcType=VARCHAR} )
mapper.select: SELECT options.model_key, options.mode, options.version, r.label, r.model_name FROM (SELECT DISTINCT model_key, mode, version FROM model_events) options LEFT JOIN agent_model_revision r ON options.version = CONCAT(r.profile_id, '/v', r.revision) ORDER BY options.mode, r.label, r.revision, options.version

, scopes AS ( SELECT model_key, outcome, attempt, duration_ms FROM filtered UNION ALL SELECT NULL, outcome, attempt, duration_ms FROM filtered ), ranked AS ( SELECT scopes.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY model_key ORDER BY duration_ms IS NULL, duration_ms) AS latency_rank, COUNT(duration_ms) OVER (PARTITION BY model_key) AS latency_samples FROM scopes ) SELECT model_key, COUNT(*) AS attempts, SUM(outcome = 'SUCCEEDED') AS succeeded, SUM(outcome = 'FAILED') AS failed, SUM(CASE WHEN attempt > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS retries, AVG(duration_ms) AS average_ms, MIN(CASE WHEN latency_rank >= CEIL(latency_samples * 0.95) THEN duration_ms END) AS p95_ms FROM ranked GROUP BY model_key
SELECT DATE(DATE_ADD(created_at, INTERVAL 8 HOUR)) AS observed_date, SUM(outcome = 'SUCCEEDED') AS succeeded, SUM(outcome = 'FAILED') AS failed FROM filtered GROUP BY observed_date
SELECT reason, COUNT(*) AS attempts FROM filtered WHERE outcome = 'FAILED' GROUP BY reason ORDER BY attempts DESC, reason

SELECT f.id, f.created_at, t.task_no, f.event_no, f.model_key, f.attempt, f.outcome, f.reason, f.duration_ms FROM filtered f JOIN agent_task t ON t.id = f.task_id WHERE (#{outcome,jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NULL OR f.outcome = #{outcome,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) AND (#{beforeTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} IS NULL OR (f.created_at, f.id) < (#{beforeTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{beforeId,jdbcType=BIGINT})) ORDER BY f.created_at DESC, f.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
